channel.title: VibePicks: new AI tool releases
channel.description: Verified AI tool and model launches that matter to people shipping apps, each with a source link.

item.title: Cloudflare Agents SDK: New createAI function in the agents package gives the AI SDK one provider for Workers AI models, AI Gateway catalog mode…
item.description: New createAI function in the agents package gives the AI SDK one provider for Workers AI models, AI Gateway catalog models, dynamic routes and vendor models, with fallbacks, caching and stream resume; workers-ai-provider and ai-gateway-provider are now deprecated

item.title: OpenAI API: You can now choose 12-hour prompt caching in the Responses API, so shared instructions, tools and context stay cached at…
item.description: You can now choose 12-hour prompt caching in the Responses API, so shared instructions, tools and context stay cached at the lower cached-input rate even when requests are hours apart; 12-hour cache writes cost 2.5x the input token price

item.title: Vercel: WebSocket support in Vercel Functions is now generally available, for AI chat, streaming and realtime multiplayer apps, …
item.description: WebSocket support in Vercel Functions is now generally available, for AI chat, streaming and realtime multiplayer apps, at the same limits and pricing as other Function invocations (CPU billed only while processing messages)

item.title: Supabase: Your coding agent can now query your Supabase logs, and a new Supabase skill points it to the signals to watch: error sp…
item.description: Your coding agent can now query your Supabase logs, and a new Supabase skill points it to the signals to watch: error spikes, security issues, slow queries and growing usage, on a schedule you choose

item.title: Claude Code: v2.1.304 adds /auto-mode-setup, a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your…
item.description: v2.1.304 adds /auto-mode-setup, a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your setup, warns Pro and Max users when resuming an old conversation would use a noticeable share of their 5-hour limit, and fixes claude --worktree deleting a worktree and its branch at exit without asking, which could lose commits

item.title: Mercury 3 (Inception): Inception's Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM that writes 1,000+ tokens per second with a 1M-token context, is live on Inceptio…
item.description: Inception's Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM that writes 1,000+ tokens per second with a 1M-token context, is live on Inception's OpenAI-compatible API (new keys get 100M free tokens) and on OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel AI Gateway; launch price is $0.10/$0.35 per million tokens, 50% off its $0.20/$0.70 list price

item.title: Cloudflare Workers AI: Clairic, a new extraction model in preview on Workers AI (@cf/cloudflare/clairic), pulls typed values like invoice total…
item.description: Clairic, a new extraction model in preview on Workers AI (@cf/cloudflare/clairic), pulls typed values like invoice totals, dates and lists out of text or up to four images, with a confidence score on every answer, for $0.10 per million input tokens and no output charge; open weights are planned

item.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: MiniMax's new fast model for coding, agent work and visual reasoning (74% on DeepSWE) is live on the MiniMax API at a fl…
item.description: MiniMax's new fast model for coding, agent work and visual reasoning (74% on DeepSWE) is live on the MiniMax API at a flat $0.15/$0.60 per million tokens, about 1/3 the cost of M3 at 3x the speed; open weights arrive Oct 23

item.title: Vercel: AI Gateway logs now have a Sessions view that groups requests by conversation and shows which coding agent ran it (Claud…
item.description: AI Gateway logs now have a Sessions view that groups requests by conversation and shows which coding agent ran it (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), plus its cost, models and cache hit rate

item.title: Replit: OpenAI is now the preferred partner powering Replit Agent's default experience, CEO Amjad Masad says; Replit stays model…
item.description: OpenAI is now the preferred partner powering Replit Agent's default experience, CEO Amjad Masad says; Replit stays model-agnostic, so you can still pick Anthropic's Claude and other supported models

item.title: DeepSeek API: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 now powers the deepseek-flash API model (open weights on Hugging Face), and DeepSeek's Search a…
item.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 now powers the deepseek-flash API model (open weights on Hugging Face), and DeepSeek's Search and Fetch web APIs are open to all developers at $0.75 per 1,000 calls

item.title: Claude Code: v2.1.302 turns on fork subagents by default in claude -p, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code (CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_S…
item.description: v2.1.302 turns on fork subagents by default in claude -p, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code (CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 turns them off), adds an idle-compaction toggle in /config, and warns that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026

item.title: Amp: You can now see and control your macOS or Linux runner's desktop from Amp, handy for trying native apps (like iOS apps) …
item.description: You can now see and control your macOS or Linux runner's desktop from Amp, handy for trying native apps (like iOS apps) that Amp builds for you; turn on Share This Mac's Display or run amp --no-tui --desktop

item.title: Glimpse (Elorian): New visual-reasoning model that keeps re-checking images and video while it thinks (it can crop, pull frames and run cod…
item.description: New visual-reasoning model that keeps re-checking images and video while it thinks (it can crop, pull frames and run code); research preview with API access at $0.60/$3 per million tokens, also on OpenRouter

item.title: ChatGPT: ChatGPT Slides: build a deck from a chat, files or an outline, edit it with teammates in real time, present from ChatGPT…
item.description: ChatGPT Slides: build a deck from a chat, files or an outline, edit it with teammates in real time, present from ChatGPT, or export to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides; rolling out to Pro, Business and Enterprise users with Space access

item.title: Beam (Reflection): Beam, a 501B-parameter (23B active) open-weight model for coding and agents, is out under Apache 2.0 with the open-sourc…
item.description: Beam, a 501B-parameter (23B active) open-weight model for coding and agents, is out under Apache 2.0 with the open-source Mirror CLI; free to start on Reflection's API and also on OpenRouter, Vercel, Ollama and other partners

item.title: Cursor: Cloud agents can now build interactive canvases (dashboards, reports) you share with a link; Environments API in beta; c…
item.description: Cloud agents can now build interactive canvases (dashboards, reports) you share with a link; Environments API in beta; cloud environments now hold up to 300 repos and large ones load 5x faster

item.title: Junie Local (JetBrains): JetBrains' free on-device coding agent runs on NVIDIA RTX Spark at launch, and Windows support is now stable on RTX card…
item.description: JetBrains' free on-device coding agent runs on NVIDIA RTX Spark at launch, and Windows support is now stable on RTX cards with 24 GB+ VRAM: no token bill, and your code never leaves the machine
